# Occurrences of the @ConfigProperty Kotlin-default defect present on 2026-08-03, frozen so the
# gate blocks NEW ones without forcing a same-night fleet sweep.
#
# Why they are not simply fixed: removing the default makes the configuration START APPLYING, so
# every entry here is a potential live behaviour change wherever the deployed value disagrees with
# the Kotlin fallback. Measured example — openbank-mcp-service sets MCP_OBO_ENABLED="true" in
# gitops while the Kotlin default is false, so staff on-behalf-of admission has never been on;
# 'fixing' it switches OBO live on a money-adjacent surface. That needs a human, not a sweep.
#
# Removing an entry is the fix. Adding one needs a reason.
# Tracked by the sweep issue; see the script header for the full diagnosis.
